name: Data Analysis and Machine Learning for Process Systems
description: Preparation of process data for machine learning: data description, outlier detection, over-sampling, under-sampling, basics of databases. Application of supervised learning on process data: regression, decision trees and ensemble methods, support vector machines, neural network, convolutional neural network, recurrent neural network and natural language processing. Application of unsupervised learning on process data: clustering, auto-encoders. Application of reinforced learning on process data. Application of machine learning: fault diagnosis in process plant, surrogate modeling of process systems, batch plant scheduling, control of bioprocesses, and evaluating the polymer recycling technologies.
